markets.note: Legal SERP is written for a foreigner marrying a Vietnamese citizen, by law firms and visa agents. Age figures conflict across snippets (18 vs 20 for men). Research must settle from moj.gov.vn or chinhphu.vn.

cross_market_insights: The head keyword is pure venue intent in every Australian city: listicles from a Singapore magazine, a tour operator and a Vietnam travel blog. None of the top 3 covers legal steps, paperwork or the Australian side.

The legal SERP ('getting married in vietnam') is the opposite: Vietnamese law firms and visa agents writing for a foreigner marrying a Vietnamese national. Nobody addresses two non-resident foreigners (the real Australian destination couple), and a Facebook thread titled 'Marriage between two foreigners in Da Nang' shows the question is live and unanswered.
PAA in all four locations opens with 'Can foreigners get married in Vietnam?'. The AI Overview does not answer it.
Ranking snippets contradict each other on minimum age (18 vs 20); the AI Overview quotes cost figures from TikTok and Reddit. Official sourcing is a clear differentiator.
Brisbane and HCMC rank a placeholder exact-match domain at #1: the SERP is weak and winnable with a well-structured, sourced page.
Nobody covers recognition in Australia, the marry-at-home route, or the logistics around a Da Nang, Hoi An or Phu Quoc celebration for 70 to 110 guests.
